name: Black Nirvana
source:
Waking up in a world composed of pure blackness, Vincent seeks to asset his eldritch environment. Despite how otherworldly the situation feels, all answers regarding that dark realm are buried deep inside Vincent's cognition. It's now up to him to unearth that knowledge, and to decide whatever to stay in that cold stillness, or to reach out to the blazing uncertainty awaiting outside.

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/black_nirvana.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
文森特在一个纯粹黑暗的世界中醒来，他试图利用他那可怕的环境。尽管情况感觉多么超凡脱俗，但所有关于那个黑暗领域的答案都深深地埋藏在文森特的认知中。现在由他来挖掘这些知识，并决定是留在寒冷的寂静中，还是接触外面等待着的炽热的不确定性。

[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/black_nirvana.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
